FAQ.title: Frequently Asked Questions
FAQ.subtitle: Everything you need to know about the product and billing.
FAQ.q1: Is Crave suitable for small agencies?
FAQ.a1: Absolutely. Crave is designed to scale with your business, whether you're a solo freelancer or a growing agency.
FAQ.q2: How does the Gatekeeper feature work?
FAQ.a2: When you upload the final deliverable, it's stored securely. The client can only download it after the system verifies the final payment has been made via the integrated payment gateway.
FAQ.q3: Can clients see internal team chats?
FAQ.a3: No. Crave has separate channels for internal team communication and client-facing updates to maintain professionalism.
FAQ.a4: Currently, we focus on local gateways (IDR via Midtrans/Xendit), but multi-currency support is on our roadmap.
